notes.title: Version 1.0 Released
notes.content:
Added Character speech
Added Boss death effects
Added Wave end effects
Changed When the final boss is defeated, the game automatically ends with victory
Improved Character HP Bar visibility
Fixed Character HUD getting stuck on screen when it dies
Fixed silent error logging in LateUpdate.
Fixed some calculation issues with boss damage
Fixed "No_Translation_Available" error for German
Game Engine Upgrade (final version)

notes.title: Build 0.1.7 Released!
notes.content:
Release Notes

Added Movement vfx
Added HDR rendering support
Added Game rendering optimization by removing redundant rendering pass
Added Spatial compensation to item indicator positions so that they are more intuitive
Fixed Round time being longer in later rounds
Fixed Graphics where some monsters would be rendered blue for a while
Changed Game Speed to 120% 
Improved UI position tracking performance
Improved GPU memory usage
Improved Shadow culling for better performance
Upgraded Game Engine

notes.title: Build 0.1.6 Released!
notes.content:
Added New item Bloodbound
Added Boss statistics to post wave report
Added Critical Hit Healing to Dreadring
Added Hit Healing to items
Improved Factoring of UI layers
Improved Boss HP UI and logic animation
Fixed ESC key prompting "Not Enough Cavarium" during upgrade screen
Fixed Text string spacing
Fixed Incorrect localization for certain key words
Game Engine Upgrade

notes.title: Build 0.1.5 Released
notes.content:
Added Apprentice gains xp per heal casted
Added "Gain XP Heal Cast" attribute to some magic items
Improved Shrine spawn to prevent all shrines bunching up
Improved Player damage detection 
Improved Damage and XP text handling performance
Improved Screen brightness and gamma
Improved UI rendering
Improved Lobby UI animation quality
Improved World rendering performance
Fixed Critical bug regarding game over conditions
Fixed Incorrect calculation of grid position for item spawn
Fixed Minimap shrine icon fill offset being incorrect
Fixed Level up price showing up as "Max Level" if the level up cost is 1
Fixed rare cases of duplicate damage
Game Engine Upgrade


Enjoy!

notes.title: Build 0.1.4 Released!
notes.content:
Added Boss enemy system
Added New boss Dragon
Added Shrines (Healing, Haste, Experience and Magic) and their systems
Added New XP calculation and UI system
Added New game conditions
Added range indicator for self destructing monsters
Added DLAA support
Improved Refactored item indicators
Improved Magic damage calculation and stat logic
Improved Player unit damage taking algorithm
Improved Default option settings to be set to higher graphical fidelity
Improved Minimap to display more information
Improved Memory management between waves
Improved Sound tracks loading to async
Fixed Item dots not updating immediately on Mini Map
Fixed Refresh rate related bug
Fixed VFX particle effects using more GPU on some hardware
Fixed Discrepancies in unit stat calculation in certain conditions
Fixed Audio effects not playing in some cases
Fixed Perk Selection pausing for a second if there isn't a unit to apply the effects
Fixed Crashing issue with Lucky Level if all units are Level 10


FYI, Keyboard control rework + formations rework is still WIP. 
Enjoy!

notes.title: Build 0.1.3 Released!
notes.content:
Added Item fx so that certain items change unit appearance
Added Prioritized return to position feature (Doesn't try to block or attack, but gains 1.8 speed)
Added Prioritized return VFX
Added Item icons to units during upgrade phase
Added Small item icon textures for better readability
Added Unit position cancel if other action is triggered (eg. item window)
Added Wave text during upgrade
Improved Minimap UI
Improved Keymap Layout UI
Improved Memory management and overall reduction of garbage generation
Changed Evade probability to be prioritized before blocking
Changed Final wave to show up as "Final Wave"
Fixed Unit HP bar during upgrade showing full HP after a stage reset
Fixed Upgrade trigger UI text overlapping
Fixed Logic error with Heart of Warrior as it was reflecting damage in incorrect situations 
Fixed Evade Chivalry request overriding Evade probability for non melee units
Fixed VFX effects glittering in rare cases
Fixed Incorrect shadow rendering
Fixed UI texture getting distorted in certain resolution


Many players have suggested that instead of the formation dynamically adapting to the number of surviving units, it would rather be better if there was a set grid to place characters in. I cannot say for sure how long it will take, but formations rework is about 50% done and I will add it to the game as soon as it is ready.

notes.title: Build 0.1.2 Released
notes.content:
Added Mini map
Added Height adjustment to item window so that it automatically adjusts
Added Item combination hints to codex for locked items
Added Spike monster to be priority enemy - archers and above will attack them first like red slime
Added Text for codex to clarify the condition of codex registration of items
Improved Class Upgrade text during Management Screen
Improved field item indicators to less obstruct ui
Improved items to stay after class upgrade
Fixed Nightwalker item options missing (Evade and Increased HP)
Fixed not being able to drag the game window

notes.title: Build 0.1.1 Released
notes.content:
Build 0.1.1 Release Notes
First patch release for O! Holy Knight! If you have suggestions, feedback or anything, kindly leave a me a note via the forum. Enjoy!

Added key controls UI to pause menu
Improved field item distance marker to update immediately upon spawn
Improved internal resource pool cleanup to happen more frequently
Fixed unit level box flashing in the center for a frame
Fixed splash sound over loading
Fixed Watch Tower not activating in certain conditions
